title: There
label: ch:mr-there
canDo: I can write the aspirated dental थ, and answer a where-question with tithe instead of naming a city.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R39-there and run one place exchange end to end: ask kuṭhe, answer tithe, then ask kā and decline with māhīt nāhī.
payoff.note: One letter and one word, in that order: तिथे cannot be read until थ is taught, which is why the chapter is shaped this way rather than by topic.
